article_title: ChatGPT Work 实测：与 Chat 到底差在哪
core_theme: ChatGPT Work 与普通 Chat 的真实能力差异：联网代码执行、无头浏览器、跨会话持久文件、ChatGPT Sites、子代理，以及随之而来的安全边界

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 对比 ChatGPT 普通 Chat 与 ChatGPT Work 的真实能力差异——Work 额外拥有联网代码执行、无头浏览器、跨会话持久文件、可发布的 Sites 与子代理，并伴随安全边界。The reader should quickly feel that the official positioning only talks about purpose, while the real difference is capability: on the Work side, an opened capability workshop. Summary angle: 双入口对照——左侧是普通对话入口，右侧打开后是一间能力车间（联网执行管线、浏览器窗口、工具目录），车间外一道护栏。Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration. Information blocks: 1) contrast: two entrances side by side, left an ordinary conversation entrance, right an opened capability workshop; visible label "Chat / Work", numeric fact 2. 2) mechanism: inside the workshop, a pipeline extending from a terminal toward the outer network, plus a browser window; visible label "联网执行". 3) evidence: an opened tool catalog / list page; visible label "223 工具", numeric fact 223. 4) takeaway: a low guard rail around the workshop; no text label, numeric fact 3. Main metaphor: a door with two sides, left and right. Subject: the opened capability workshop entrance on the right, with an execution pipeline, a browser window, and a tool catalog extending out of it. Composition/framing: left-right contrast (Chat on the left, Work on the right), horizontal narrative, legible in a wide cover. Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: low-saturation arthouse illustration, quiet composition, subtle grain, muted colors, reflective emotional tone. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: 米灰、深灰、低饱和暗青绿，锈红作少量点缀. Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips: "Chat / Work" (product name), "联网执行", "223 工具". No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 赛博朋克紫蓝光污染、漂浮芯片、无意义代码雨、霓虹高楼背景、通用机器人站姿、巨量 HUD 浮层。
